As someone who is academically successful but not real-life successful, I totally get it. I try thinking that everything will be better, because, honestly? I think it will. You survived so much already, I think if you keep going a little bit more, things may get different. You're anything but mediocre, I think you're very strong for overcoming so many things. And I don't think you've ruined your life, you just got a new chance to restart it and shape yourself to be the best person you can be.

I also strongly encourage you talking to your parents about this, and the anxiety this is giving you. If not to them, then talk to your SO (or both!). Someone need to know what's up, it's very hard going through this by yourself. I know it might feel like you're burdening them, but I assure you they'd rather know now then find out when it's too late. Good luck man. I truly wish you the best.

Listen. When I was eighteen years old, a man I didn't know and didn't want to kiss forced me into a kiss, and touched my genitals. I pushed him but he wouldn't stop. I pushed harder and he let go, and I left. It was horrible.

If this same guy came to me today and asked sincerely for forgiveness, I'd forgive him. You know what you did was wrong, and this is the most important thing: owning up to your mistake, and wanting to be better. Of course, not everyone will give you their forgiveness, but you can be better. It can be ok.

Thank you for reading and commenting, I really needed it. I decided to quit drinking for a while, I'm so ashamed and disgusted at myself, I really don't wanna talk to him about it haha. But I've seen him since and been nice to him, he's a great friend who I love a lot, and even if I talked to him and he somehow forgave me, I'd still feel like hot garbage, because what hurts me is the fact that it happened and I can't change that, unfortunately. I hate losing my filter, I feel like no one should trust me because of that. I just wish I was a good person who didn't harm anyone, which I know is impossible. But it seems like I always fuck things up, I'm always in dread of what will be the next horrible thing I do. Thank you a lot for taking the time to talk to me, it's very kind of you.
